title: Thickenings and first order thickenings
statement: Let $T'$ be a scheme and $i:T\to T'$ a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], so that $T$ is a closed subscheme of $T'$, and let $\mathcal I=\ker(\mathcal O_{T'}\to i_*\mathcal O_T)\subseteq\mathcal O_{T'}$ be its ideal sheaf, the quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals defining $T$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. (1) $T'$ is a *thickening* of $T$ if moreover the underlying topological spaces of $T$ and $T'$ are equal, i.e. the map of underlying spaces of $i$ is surjective (it is then a homeomorphism, $i$ being a homeomorphism onto a closed subset). (2) $T'$ is a *first order thickening* of $T$ if $\mathcal I$ has square zero, $\mathcal I^2=0$ [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers]. (3) $T'$ is a *finite order thickening* of $T$ if $\mathcal I$ is nilpotent, i.e. $\mathcal I^{n+1}=0$ for some integer $n\ge0$, and an *$n$th order thickening* if $\mathcal I^{n+1}=0$ [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers]. (A finite order thickening, in particular a first order one, is a thickening: on an affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}R$ of $T'$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] with $i^{-1}(U)=\operatorname{Spec}(R/I)$, $I=\mathcal I(U)$ satisfies $I^{n+1}=0$, so $I$ lies in every prime ideal of $R$ and $\operatorname{Spec}(R/I)\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ is surjective.) (4) Let $S$ be a scheme. A thickening (of any of the kinds above) *over $S$* is one in which $T$ and $T'$ are schemes over $S$ and $i$ is a morphism over $S$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base]; equivalently, $T'$ is given a morphism $T'\to S$ and $T$ is over $S$ through the composite $T\to T'\to S$. It is a thickening *of affine schemes* if $T$ and $T'$ are affine schemes [def-pc-scheme]; since $i^{-1}(T')=T\cong\operatorname{Spec}(R/I)$ when $T'=\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], this holds as soon as $T'$ is affine.

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against Stacks Definition 37.2.1 (Tag 04EX, more-morphisms.tex) and the use of 'first order thickening of affine schemes over S' in Definition 37.11.1 (Tag 02H0). Rewrote the statement as items (1)-(4) of Tag 04EX plus 'over S' (item (6)) and 'of affine schemes'; 'equal underlying spaces' is stated as surjectivity of i on points. Replaced the statement dependency def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions (an unsplit bundle) by the notions actually used: def-pc-scheme (schemes, affine schemes), def-weil-closed-immersion (IsClosedImmersion), def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-scheme-over-base (schemes and morphisms over S), and two new Mathlib leaves: def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf (Scheme.Hom.ker, with Hom.ker_apply on affine opens) and def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers (products/powers in the semiring Scheme.IdealSheafData, square zero I^2 = ⊥, nilpotent IsNilpotent). The two parenthetical claims of the statement (finite order thickenings are thickenings; T is affine when T' is) are now justified inline from the affine description of closed immersions in def-weil-closed-immersion. Mathlib has no thickening declaration; the notion is assembled in one line from the leaves (search recorded).
